name: CDC Maddington DC1

address.note: campus site: Lots 1, 10, 1 (No. 307, 323, 329) Kenwick Road & Lot 500 (No. 582) Bickley Road, Maddington (7.6 ha; lots to be amalgamated, condition 5). Building MA.1 (south-west end, off Bickley Rd) per DA site plan.

lat.note: Geocoded 2026-09-27 from '307 Kenwick Road, Maddington WA 6109' with the ArcGIS World Geocoder (PointAddress, score 100). Campus-level point for the lot at 307 Kenwick Rd; the building's position on the campus is unknown.

builder.note: no head contractor named in DAP documents, CDC or press sources checked (Sept 2026)

developer.note: owner Canberra Data Centres Proprietary Ltd; applicant/planning consultant Developed (Developed Property) per RAR

mw_it.note: per-building IT MW not stated. Campus: 150MW IT capacity (CDC deputation, src 1); 145MW in Stantec acoustic report (src 7); 200MW marketed by CDC/Developed (src 4, 9). Building MA.1 has 4 of the campus's 24 data halls (site plan, src 7); pro-rata by halls would be ~25MW of 150MW - estimate only, not recorded as value. DC1 assumed to correspond to DA building MA.1.

mw_grid.note: not stated; acoustic report assumes five 55MVA transformers in the future substation (src 7), which is a separate DA (condition 13)

cost_aud_m.note: RAR 'Value of Development: $415 million' for the whole four-building application; CDC/press describe A$415m as the first-stage investment (src 9, 12). Recorded against stage 1 (MA.1/DC1); whether it covers only stage 1 or the whole DA is ambiguous

authority.value: Metro Outer Development Assessment Panel (City of Gosnells responsible authority)

pathway.note: Form 1 mandatory DAP application, lodged as 'Proposed Warehouses and Ancillary Structures'; one approval covers all four buildings, built in four stages

lodged.note: RAR 'Application Received Date: 24 June 2025'. PlanningAlerts listed DA25/00259 on 7 Jun 2025 (src 2), i.e. City received it earlier in June

determined.note: approved unanimously (primary motion as amended) at MODAP/102 on 10 Sep 2025. Condition 2: valid four years from approval; lapses if not substantially commenced by ~2029-09-10. Earlier '22 Sep 2025' in master.csv not supported

jobs_construction.note: no construction workforce figure in RAR/planning report; CDC says 'thousands of jobs across multiple industries throughout the course of construction and into operation' (src 5) - unquantified

jobs_operational_other.note: campus-wide (all four buildings): RAR 'A maximum of 110 staff working from the site to maintain the data centre'

construction_start.note: after 10 Sep 2025 approval; planning report says stage 1 to commence within 2 years of determination (src 7); site reported 'under construction' by 30 Jul 2026 (src 10). Exact start not found

construction_end.note: expected; CDC (Aug 2025) said the centre 'will be operational in 2026'

open_questions: per-building IT MW not stated (campus 150MW in DA vs 200MW marketed)
whether A$415m DA value covers stage 1 only or the whole campus
